format: long: one row per task x representation x metric (x stat)

columns.suite: result family (v2_frozen, v2_sensitivity, v2_exploratory_posthoc, legacy_bio_validation, umap_neighborhood, encode_ewas_matched_single_draw, encode_exp5_base, encode_exp5_probe, encode_exp2_decodability, encode_co_methylation)
columns.task_id: suite/endpoint; unique task key used by the matrix, audit and coverage files
columns.task_name: endpoint / set name as in the results file
columns.stat_name: exact statistic name in the source file (or derived name)
columns.stat_class: class attached to the stat in the source (primary/secondary/sensitivity/descriptive/...)
columns.is_headline: true for the stat that represents the task in bio_task_matrix.csv (primary_stat or the AUROC/mean-AUC; r2 companions)
columns.biological_family: vocabulary: genomic locus identity | regulatory activity | disease/pathology | aging | environmental exposure | 3D genome | replication timing | methylation program | other
columns.positive_n: number of positives (blank when not applicable/unknown)
columns.matching_covariates: covariates matched between positives and negatives
columns.representation_raw: arm id exactly as in the results file
columns.representation_id: normalized id: regulatory_histone_dnase_v1 | cpgpt_large_locus | deepcpg_dna_locus | functional_annotations_pca [legacy] | other:*
columns.representation_variant: native 512D vs compact 256D, store variant, etc.
columns.representation_dim: embedding width (blank for raw feature subsets)
columns.is_main_panel: true only for the three main-panel arms in their native form (candidate 256D SVD, CpGPT-large native 512D, DeepCpG native 128D)
columns.proxy_for: main-panel arm this non-panel variant approximates (blank if none)
columns.metric: vocabulary: AUROC | AUPRC | Spearman | Pearson | R2 | MAE | MSE | accuracy | F1 | precision | recall | enrichment | neighbor_hit_rate | neighbor_fraction | random_fraction | delta_cosine | mean_neighbor_correlation | mean_matched_correlation | correlation_gap
columns.score: metric value as stored (never imputed; blank = undefined)
columns.ci_definition: mandatory when a CI is present
columns.source_sha256: sha256 of source_file at build time
columns.git_commit_recorded: repo head recorded by the run manifest (v2 only)
columns.protocol_tag: frozen protocol git tag if any
columns.status: vocabulary: frozen | preregistered | exploratory | discovery-campaign | legacy-unregistered
columns.circularity_level: circularity applicable to THIS row's representation: INDEPENDENT | PARTIALLY_RELATED | SOURCE_RETENTION

family_mapping_rules.genomic locus identity: CpG context classes, conservation, genomic proximity
family_mapping_rules.aging: age EWAS and clock CpG sets
family_mapping_rules.methylation program: Loyfer cell-type profiles/markers, mean beta, co-methylation

files.bio_task_paired_contrasts.csv: 853 rows (paired deltas as published; never constructed here)
files.unscored_tasks.csv: probes that errored / lacked support (no score)

matrix_columns.{arm}__{metric}[__ci_lo|__ci_hi]: arm in cand|cpgpt|deepcpg|funcleg; metric in auroc|auprc|spearman|r2|enrichment; AUPRC has no CI
matrix_columns.{metric}__ci_definition: CI definition for that metric's intervals
matrix_columns.proxy_arm_* / proxy_metric_* / proxy_val: proxy variant used when the main arm is missing (headline metric only)
matrix_columns.candidate_minus_{cpgpt|deepcpg|funcleg}_: paired delta exactly as published (blank: none)
matrix_columns.delta_flag: 'no paired CI available' when no published paired delta exists for the task

conventions.circularity_level: per-row, for the row's own representation
conventions.scores: never invented; blanks where undefined or not computed
conventions.legacy_AUC: legacy bio_validation AUROC is the mean of fold AUROCs
conventions.legacy_functional_variants: functional_annotations_pca appears in two store variants (campaign full SVD256 vs older PCA store)
